summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests lutetium-177-PSMA-617, a radiopharmaceutical therapy, in adults with IDH wild type gliomas that express PSMA, after standard treatment. Patients take temozolomide by mouth on the first 5 days of each 28-day cycle, and 177Lu-PSMA-617 is given as 2 to 6 total doses, spaced about 4 weeks apart, on day 2 of the first two cycles. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; the brief summary says the study aims to find out whether the treatment is safe.
summary_es: Este estudio de Fase 1 evalúa lutecio-177-PSMA-617, una terapia con radiofármacos, en adultos con gliomas IDH silvestre que expresan PSMA, después del tratamiento estándar. Los pacientes toman temozolomida por vía oral durante los primeros 5 días de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el 177Lu-PSMA-617 se administra en 2 a 6 dosis totales, separadas aproximadamente 4 semanas, el día 2 de los primeros dos ciclos. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; el resumen breve señala que el estudio busca saber si el tratamiento es seguro.
who_for: Confirmed WHO grade 2-4 glioma that is IDH1 R132H-wildtype, of a listed type
PSMA-positive tumor sample by immunohistochemistry from a pre-radiotherapy biopsy or resection
Completed standard treatment, including surgery where possible and adjuvant radiation therapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 2 or less
Adequate kidney, liver, and blood counts, and able to understand and sign consent
not_for: Known non-canonical IDH mutations other than R132H
Target lesion within 5 mm of the brainstem, optic chiasm, or optic nerves
Receipt of bevacizumab as part of initial glioma treatment
Current or planned pregnancy, or refusal to follow contraception requirements
